messages:
Lina Gomez: Quick sync 1 had a POC that got stuck because CPQ routing didn't account for multi-quarter commits + negotiated discounts. We need clearer Deal Desk routing and an SLA we can promise to customers.
Theo Park: We currently only route on `Price_Exception__c`. That's too coarse. We should introduce `Computed_Route__c` and `Route_Reason__c` to make queue filtering easy.
Ravi Desai: Agreed. Proposed compute logic: if Commit_Months__c >= 6 OR Discount_Percent__c > 0.15 OR Legal_Changes_Requested__c = TRUE -> Computed_Route__c = 'deal-desk'. Else 'standard'.
Lina Gomez: Add `Requires_Security_Review__c` as well. If true -> Computed_Route__c = 'deal-desk-security' so security gets auto-tagged.
Theo Park: SLA mapping suggestion: populate `Approval_SLA__c` with human-readable tokens: '24h', '48h', '72h'. Rules: estimated_ARR <= 50000 -> 24h; 50k-250k -> 48h; >250k or legal changes -> 72h. CPQ should set this on route.
Ravi Desai: Also set `SLA_Expires_At__c` timestamp so the queue can surface overdue items and auto-escalations. Add `Auto_Escalated__c` boolean when escalated.
LegalBot: Note: when Legal_Changes_Requested__c = TRUE attach `Requested_Template_Id__c` and set `Legal_Priority__c`. Default template: STD_NDA_V2.
Lina Gomez: Operational asks: 1) add computed flag & reason; 2) SLA fields; 3) template id; 4) routing audit trail `DealRouteHistory__c` (text) for debugging.
Theo Park: I'll open a ticket and patch sandbox. Can someone provide sample SOQLs and test vectors?
Ravi Desai: Sample validation SOQL:```sql
SELECT Id, Commit_Months__c, Discount_Percent__c, Computed_Route__c, Route_Reason__c, Approval_SLA__c, SLA_Expires_At__c FROM Opportunity WHERE Id = 'OPP-5555'
```
Lina Gomez: Escalation flow: when SLA_Expires_At__c < NOW() and Auto_Escalated__c = FALSE -> set Auto_Escalated__c = TRUE and ping `#deal-desk-escalations` + email DealDeskLead. Need `Escalation_Contact__c` field for fallback.
Theo Park: Ticket created DD-1202 for CPQ routing changes (owner: @Theo Park)  https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/DD-1202
Ravi Desai: I'll draft test cases: small deal w/ 10% discount -> standard; 9-month commit -> deal-desk with reason 'commit-length'; security flag true -> deal-desk-security and SLA 48h or 72h depending on ARR.
Lina Gomez: Timeline: patch sandbox tomorrow, validation by EOD, flip staging next week if green.
Theo Park: Will post sandbox logs and SOQL outputs in this thread.
Lina Gomez: Thanks team. If we can lock SLA values and escalation steps today we can include in the sales playbook.
Ravi Desai: I'll update the playbook after tests. :thumbsup:
Lina Gomez: Sounds good. Closing action items: Theo -> DD-1202 sandbox + deploy plan; Ravi -> test matrix + playbook updates; LegalBot -> template list confirmation.
deal-bot: created DD-1202 and added watchers: @Lina Gomez, @Ravi Desai, @LegalBot
